name: com.mailgun/mailgun-mcp-server
title: Mailgun MCP Server
description: An MCP server for sending email, investigating deliverability, and managing Mailgun accounts.

environmentVariables.name: MAILGUN_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: JSON describing one or more Mailgun accounts, e.g. {"accounts":{"acme":{"apiKey":"key-...","region":"us"}},"defaultAccount":"acme"}. Required unless MAILGUN_ACCOUNTS_FILE or MAILGUN_API_KEY is set.

environmentVariables.name: MAILGUN_ACCOUNTS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the MAILGUN_ACCOUNTS JSON.

environmentVariables.name: MAILGUN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Single Mailgun API key from https://app.mailgun.com/settings/api_security, registered as the account 'default'. Used when MAILGUN_ACCOUNTS and MAILGUN_ACCOUNTS_FILE are unset.

environmentVariables.name: MAILGUN_API_REGION
environmentVariables.description: API region for MAILGUN_API_KEY: us or eu
